miku.name: Hatsune Miku
miku.feature_clause: featuring Hatsune Miku as the only physical character
miku.identity: Preserve her unmistakable canonical identity: luminous aqua eyes, straight aqua bangs, extremely long aqua twin tails, black-and-magenta square hair ornaments, youthful anime facial structure, slim proportions, and a clearly recognizable Hatsune Miku silhouette. Keep her face, eyes, hands, hair ornaments and long twin-tail identity immediately readable even inside this dense structure.
palette: pure white, pearl white and pale silver
miku.guard: no duplicate Miku, no generic blue-haired girl, no missing twin-tail silhouette

furina.name: Furina from Genshin Impact
furina.feature_clause: featuring Furina from Genshin Impact as the only physical character
furina.identity: Preserve Furina’s unmistakable canonical identity: pale skin, refined youthful face, short-to-medium white hair with distinctive pale-blue tips and longer flowing rear sections, elegant blue heterochromatic eyes, her signature dark navy top hat with blue-and-white ornamentation, and her recognizable Fontaine-inspired navy, white, black, and gold ceremonial outfit. Keep her face, eyes, hat, hands, hair silhouette, and aristocratic Furina identity immediately readable through the highly elaborate composition.
